name: Unidentified Arquitens-class light cruiser
description: An Arquitens-class light cruiser served the navy of the Galactic Empire. After the Empire attacked the Son-tuul Pride crime syndicate and confiscated their fortune, the credits were to be transferred to an Imperial vault aboard the Arquitens-class light cruiser. The rogue archaeologist Doctor Chelli Aphra, under discreet orders from the Sith Lord and Imperial enforcer Darth Vader, led a crew of bounty hunters in a robbery of the Son-tuul Pride's credits.
